_source: Copy of the open rows in boi-ops docs/specs/alert-standard.md (section 4). The boi-ops file is the record; this copy lets the health check and the Morning Brief read it. Update both in the same change.
_rule: An open row's alerts are not emailed. They appear on the Morning Brief known-issues card. A row leaves only when its fix is merged and one clean run is seen.
